exact.Człowiek testowy zostaje zamieniony w an: The test human is turned into an android (the same as the chaplain's ritual does). 1) Examine them with a health analyzer or look at them → expected: all limbs are robotic (metallic look), not organic. 2) The android's left arm is damaged (20 brute): use the first-aid kit from the chamber's permanent equipment on it → expected: it does not heal the robotic limb. 3) Use a welder on it (target: that arm, help intent) → expected: heals brute damage; similarly a cable heals burn. 4) The second human is a regular one for comparison → expected: their limbs are organic, the first-aid kit works on them.
exact.Człowiek, goryl, skaner DNA z konsolą, k: A human, a gorilla, a DNA scanner with a console, a cargo console with an export scanner and a full export battery are in the kit. 1) Laser Eyes: inject yourself with the injector, turn on combat mode and click the distant human from the kit → expected: a beam fires (no runtime), each shot slightly hurts the eyes. 2) Matter Eater: inject the matter eater injector, swallow an item, then inject the anti-injector → expected: the item drops out instead of disappearing. 3) DNA console: inject Thermal, Glow and Radioactive (injectors), enter the scanner and in the console combine Thermal + Glow and Thermal + Radioactive → expected: Laser Eyes and X-ray come out (requires a living human). Check the remaining injectors (Vore, Cat Claws, Fire Breath) on the same human → expected: they implant without a race block. 4) Security implant: implant it in yourself, use *deathgasp → expected: the implant does not fire; actually kill yourself (VV: call death) → expected: it speaks up on real death. 5) Put on the HEV suit → expected: a greeting appears. Circuit multitool, Hilbert analyzer and gang first aid kit → expected: they have visible icons, not empty ones. 6) Export scanner: click the cargo console with it, then the export battery → expected: a full battery on T1 valued at 2000 cr. 7) Energy gun (from the kit and from the rack) versus laser → expected: the same firing rhythm. 8) Hit the human from the kit with a sharp tool → expected: blood splatters, but the admin chat stays silent. The gorilla requires a ghost: take it over from the spawner menu if it appears.
exact.Człowiek, jaszczur, eteryk i IPC krwawią: The human, lizard, ethereal and IPC bleed from the start (a small cut that weakens by itself after approx. 2 minutes; to renew it, cut the patient with a knife in combat mode, and replenish the blood with an O- bag). 1) Examine the stains and drag marks → expected: the blood color depends on race (lizard teal, ethereal glowing, IPC light gray coolant). 2) Click the bleeding alert → expected: you press on the wound (takes a hand), the bleeding weakens. Bandage → expected: the bleeding turns into a dressing; a lighter and a laser cauterize the wound. 3) The IPC is leaking → expected: you patch it with a welder. Medbot → expected: bandages the bleeding. 4) Cut a human without armor with a knife, then in a vest → expected: armor reduces bleeding. Analyzer and stethoscope → expected: they show the bleeding rate. 5) Operating table + drape, radial menu: bleeding cauterization → expected: the bleeding stops. 6) Stomach pump on a human (patients have 30u of water in the body) → expected: vomiting and removal of 2/3 of substances (approx. 10u remain). Negative: for an IPC the stomach pump operation is not available (organics only). 7) IPC identity recalibration → expected: an ID card in the open cage changes the IPC's name. 8) A removed heart → expected: blood stops renewing. IV drip, monitor, autopsy and recovered crew - the kit of PR 457.

exact.Działo podmuchowe to wysoce wyspecjalizo: A highly specialized weapon, the Blast Cannon is actually relatively simple. It contains an attachment for a tank transfer valve mounted to an angled pipe specially constructed withstand extreme pressure and temperatures, and has a mechanical trigger for triggering the transfer valve. Essentially, it turns the explosive force of a bomb into a narrow-angle blast wave "projectile". Aspiring scientists may find this highly useful, as forcing the pressure shockwave into a narrow angle seems to be able to bypass whatever quirk of physics disallows explosive ranges above a certain distance, allowing for the device to use the theoretical yield of a transfer valve bomb, instead of the factual yield.

exact.Gdy larwa wydostała się z piersi małpy,: When the larva first emerged from the chest of the monkey, it seemed very curious. It would wander around aimlessly for awhile and then sit still. We are unable to determine the gender of the larva, or even determine if it has a gender. After some time had passed, it seemed to lose interest in its surroundings and sat mostly still while occasionally wagging its tail. We decided to throw in a live mouse to see if it would consume it. The larva quickly attacked and ate the mouse and seemed to get larger very suddenly, this suggests that the larvae are capable of metabolizing and directing all the energy towards growth at previously thought impossible speeds. exact.Jakiś szalony klaun zrobił to, żeby napr: A crazy clown made this to prank the crew really really hard.

exact.Jako <span class='danger'>żelazny golem<: As an Iron Golem, you don't have any special traits.
exact.Jako Abduktor możesz przełączać pałkę mi: As an Abductor, the baton can cycle between four modes: stun, sleep, cuff and probe.
exact.Jako Abduktor możesz wybrać w konsoli st: As an Abductor, you can select where your victims will be sent on the ship control console.

exact.Jako Barman możesz skrócić swoją strzelb: As the Bartender, you can use a circular saw on your shotgun to make it easier to store.
exact.Jako Barman zaczynasz tylko z podstawowy: As the Bartender, the drinks you start with only give you the basics. If you want more advanced mixtures, look into working with chemistry, hydroponics, or even mining for things to grind up and throw in!
exact.Jako Bibliotekarz dbaj, by półki były za: As the Curator, be sure to keep the shelves stocked and the library clean for crew.
exact.Jako Bibliotekarz nie jesteś zupełnie be: As the Curator, you are not completely defenseless. Your whip easily disarms people, your laser pointer can blind humans and cyborgs, and you can hide items in wirecut books.
exact.Jako Bicz Camarilli czerpiesz siłę ze sw: As a camarilla scourge, your newfound purpose empowers you!
exact.Jako Blob możesz atakować wszystko obok: As the Blob, you can attack anything next to a blob tile, but can only expand in cardinal directions, and diagonal attacks are slightly weaker.
exact.Jako Blob możesz losowo zmienić swój odc: As the Blob, you can randomly repick your reagent type if the crew has adapted and protected themselves against your current one.
exact.Jako Blob możesz stworzyć w fabryce Blob: As the Blob, you can produce a Blobbernaut from a factory for 40 resources. Blobbernauts are player-controlled, gradually regenerate near nodes, and apply your chemical when attacking, but die when too far from the blob or if their factory is killed. However, the factory used becomes fragile and stops spawning spores.
exact.Jako Blob możesz umieścić swój rdzeń w d: As the Blob, you can place your core at any clear, unobserved, spot you can move to after 3 minutes have passed. If you wait too long, you will be automatically placed at a random location. Use this wait time to coordinate with any other overminds.
exact.Jako Blob nie zaniedbuj budowy fabryk. T: As the Blob, don't neglect the creation of factories. These create spores that carry your reagent and can chase crewmembers far further than you. Spores can also be rallied to swarm the crew and cause panic, and can even take over corpses to create much more dangerous blob zombies!
exact.Jako Blob rozrastasz się kliknięciem, si: As the Blob, you can expand by clicking, create strong blobs with ctrl-click, rally spores with middle-click, and remove blobs with alt-click. You do not need to have your camera over the tile to do this.
exact.Jako Blob toczysz wojnę na wyniszczenie:: As the Blob, you fight a war of attrition: Take out medbay and fight in chokepoints to prevent continued assaults and coordinated burst damage attacks!
exact.Jako Blob trzymaj rdzeń z dala od kosmos: As the Blob, keep your core some distance from space, as it is both expensive to expand onto space, easy to be attacked from, and does not count towards your win condition. Emitter platforms built in space are especially dangerous.
exact.Jako Blob, mówiąc, wysyłasz wiadomość do: As the Blob, talking will send a message to all other overminds and all Blobbernauts, allowing you to direct attacks and coordinate.
exact.Jako Blob, usuwając silne bloby, węzły z: As the Blob, removing strong blobs, resource nodes, factories, and nodes will give you 4, 15, 25, and 25 resources back, respectively.
exact.Jako Blobbernaut masz na HUD swoje zdrow: As a Blobbernaut, your HUD shows your health and the core health of the overmind that created you.
exact.Jako Blobbernaut możesz rozmawiać z nadu: As a Blobbernaut, you can communicate with overminds and other Blobbernauts via :b.
exact.Jako Botanik możesz mutować rośliny w ta: As a Botanist, you can mutate the plants growing in your hydroponics trays with unstable mutagen or, as an alternative, crude radioactives from chemistry to get special variations.
exact.Jako Botanik możesz zhakować automat Meg: As a Botanist, you can hack the MegaSeed Vendor to get access to more exotic seeds. These seeds can alternatively be ordered from cargo.
exact.Jako Botanik możesz łączyć substancje z: As a Botanist, you can combine production trait chemicals just like a Chemist. Chlorine (blumpkin) + radium and phosphorus (glowshrooms) equals unstable mutagen!
exact.Jako Botanik postaraj się zwiększać moc: As a Botanist, you should look into increasing the potency of your plants. This increases the size, amount of chemicals, points gained from grinding them in the biogenerator, and lets people know you are a proficient botanist.
exact.Jako Chemik będziesz zaopatrywać załogę: As a Chemist, you will be expected to supply crew with certain chemicals. For example, clonexadone and mannitol for the cryo tubes, unstable mutagen and saltpetre for botany as well as healing pills and patches for the front desk.
exact.Jako Chemik masz do dyspozycji dziesiątk: As a Chemist, there are dozens of chemicals that can heal, and even more that can cause harm. Experiment!
exact.Jako Chemik możesz naładować dozownik ch: As a Chemist, you can recharge your chemical dispenser with an inducer or by replacing its cell.
As a Chemist, you can make 100u bottles from plastic sheets. The ChemMaster can produce infinite 30u glass bottles as well and if researched the medical techfab can make beakers with capacity ranging from 120u to 300u.
exact.Jako Chemik pamiętaj, że niektóre substa: As a Chemist, some chemicals can only be synthesized by heating up the contents with a chemical heater or manually with lighters and similar tools.
exact.Jako Chemik pamiętaj: woda zmieszana z p: As a Chemist, Water and Potassium mixed together will create an explosion, with power scaling by amount used. Don't do it.
exact.Jako Cyborg inżynieryjny możesz montować: As an Engineering Cyborg, you can attach air alarm/fire alarm/APC frames to walls by placing them on the floor and using a screwdriver on them.
exact.Jako Cyborg jesteś bardzo podatny na EMP: As a Cyborg, you are extremely vulnerable to EMPs as EMPs both stun you and damage you. The ion rifle in the armory or a traitor with an EMP kit can kill you in seconds.
exact.Jako Cyborg jesteś odporny na większość: As a Cyborg, you are immune to most forms of stunning, and excel at almost everything far better than humans. However, flashes can easily stunlock you and you cannot do any precision work as you lack hands.
exact.Jako Cyborg medyczny możesz w pełni oper: As a Medical Cyborg, you can fully perform surgery and even augment people.
exact.Jako Cyborg sprzątający jesteś zmorą wsz: As a Janitor Cyborg, you are the bane of all slaughter demons and even Bubblegum himself. Cleaning up blood stains will severely gimp them.
exact.Jako Cyborg usługowy twoja farba w spray: As a Service Cyborg, your spray can knocks people down. However, it is blocked by masks and glasses.
exact.Jako Cyborg wybieraj moduł rozważnie, bo: As a Cyborg, choose your module carefully, as only cutting and mending your reset wire will let you repick it. If possible, refrain from choosing a module until a situation that requires one occurs.
exact.Jako Czarodziej możesz strzelać laską ch: As a Wizard, the staff of chaos can fire any type of bolts from the magical wands. This can range from bolts of instant death to healing or reviving someone.
exact.Jako Czarodziej możesz zamieniać ludzi w: As a Wizard, you can turn people to stone, then animate the resulting statue with a staff of animation to create an extremely powerful minion, for all of 5 minutes at least.
exact.Jako Czarodziej pamiętaj, że kula ognia: As a Wizard, the fireball spell performs very poorly at close range, as it can easily catch you in the blast. It is best used as a form of artillery down long hallways.
exact.Jako Czarodziej pamiętaj, że większość z: As a Wizard, most spells become unusable if you are not wearing your robe, hat, and sandals.
exact.Jako Czarodziej, przywołując broń, obróc: As a Wizard, summoning guns will turn a large portion of the crew against themselves, but will also give everyone anything from a floral somatoray to a pulse rifle. Use at your own risk!
exact.Jako Detektyw możesz używać skanera krym: As the Detective, you can use your forensics scanner from a distance.
exact.Jako Detektyw możesz załadować do rewolw: As the Detective, your revolver can be loaded with .357 ammunition obtained from a hacked autolathe. Firing it has a decent chance to blow up your revolver.
exact.Jako Detektyw pamiętaj, że ludzie zostaw: As the Detective, people leave fingerprints everywhere and on everything. With the exception of white latex, gloves will hide them. All is not lost, however, as gloves leave fibers specific to their kind such as black or nitrile, pointing to a general department.
exact.Jako Dron możesz pingować inne drony, by: As a Drone, you can ping other drones to alert them of areas in the station in need of repair.
exact.Jako Duch możesz dwukrotnie kliknąć niem: As a Ghost, you can double click on just about anything to follow it. Or just warp around!
exact.Jako Duch możesz zobaczyć wnętrze leżące: As a Ghost, you can see the inside of a container on the ground by clicking on it.
exact.Jako Dyrektor Naukowy możesz wyjmować SI: As the Research Director, you can take AIs out of their cores by loading them into an intelliCard, which lets you see their laws, even ion/syndicate ones. It can then be placed into an AI system integrity restorer computer to revive and/or repair them.
exact.Jako Dyrektor Naukowy możesz zablokować: As the Research Director, you can lock down cyborgs instead of blowing them up. Then you can have their laws reset or if that doesn't work, safely dismantled.
exact.Jako Genetyk masz moc tworzenia nadludzi: As a Geneticist, you have to power to make superhumans. Be aware, going over 99 instability WILL cause side effects.
exact.Jako Genetyk możesz wcześniej wyjąć kogo: As a Geneticist, you can eject someone from cloning early by disabling power in genetics. Note that they will suffer more genetic damage and may lose vital organs from this.
exact.Jako Genetyk pamiętaj: T łączy się z A,: As a Geneticist, T goes to A, and G goes to C.

exact.Jako Górnik możesz pozyskiwać płyty z go: As a Shaft Miner, you can harvest goliath plates from goliaths and upgrade your explorer's suit, mining hardsuits as well as Firefighter APLUs with them, greatly reducing incoming melee damage.
exact.Jako Górnik możesz tworzyć różny sprzęt: As a Shaft Miner, you can craft a variety of equipment from the local fauna. Bone axes, lava boats and ash drake armour are just a few of them!
exact.Jako Górnik pamiętaj, że każdy potwór na: As a Shaft Miner, every monster on Lavaland has a pattern you can exploit to minimize damage from the encounters.
exact.Jako Górnik wiedz, że północna część Lav: As a Shaft Miner, the northern side of Lavaland has a lot more rare minerals than on the south.
exact.Jako Górnik zawsze miej przy sobie GPS,: As a Shaft Miner, always have a GPS on you, so a fellow miner or cyborg can come to save you if you die.
exact.Jako Główny Inżynier masz w biurze konso: As the Chief Engineer, the power flow control console in your office will show you APC info and lets you control them remotely.
exact.Jako Główny Inżynier masz w szafce uleps: As the Chief Engineer, your locker contains a jetpack upgrade that can be attached to hardsuits.
exact.Jako Główny Inżynier masz znacznie lepsz: As the Chief Engineer, your hardsuit is significantly better than everybody else's. It has the best features of both engineering and atmospherics hardsuits - boasting nigh-invulnerability to radiation and all atmospheric conditions, in addition to an integrated jetpack.
exact.Jako Główny Inżynier możesz szpiegować,: As the Chief Engineer, you can spy on and even forge PDA communications with the message monitor console! The key is in your office.
exact.Jako Główny Inżynier możesz zmieniać naz: As the Chief Engineer, you can rename areas or create entirely new ones using your station blueprints.
exact.Jako Inżynier co jakiś czas wracaj do in: As an Engineer, return to Engineering once in a while to check on the engine and SMES cells. It's always a good idea to make sure containment isn't compromised.

exact.Jako Inżynier możesz naprawiać okna spaw: As an Engineer, you can repair windows by using a welding tool on them while on any intent other than harm.
exact.Jako Inżynier możesz podłączyć kraty pod: As an Engineer, you can electrify grilles by placing wire "nodes" beneath them: the big seemingly unconnected bulges from a half completed wiring job.

exact.Jako Inżynier możesz tymczasowo zasilać: As an Engineer, you can temporarily power the station solely with the solar arrays. exact.Jako Inżynier możesz wytworzyć w protola: As an Engineer, your departmental protolathe and circuit printer can manufacture the necessary circuit boards and components to build just about anything. exact.Jako Inżynier możesz wyważyć grodzie bez: As an Engineer, you can pry open secure storage blast doors by disabling the engine room APC's main breaker. This is obviously a bad idea if the engine is running.
exact.Jako Inżynier możesz zablokować swoją ka: As an Engineer, you can lock APCs, fire alarms, emitters and radiation collectors using your ID card to prevent others from disabling them.
exact.Jako Inżynier możesz ładować RCD arkusza: As an Engineer, your RCD can be reloaded with iron, glass or plasteel sheets instead of just compressed matter cartridges.
exact.Jako Inżynier nie lekceważ skromnych gen: As an Engineer, don't underestimate the humble P.A.C.M.A.N. generators. With upgraded parts, a couple units working in tandem are sufficient to take over for an exploded engine or shattered solars.
exact.Jako Inżynier pamiętaj, że odłamek super: As an Engineer, the supermatter shard is an extremely dangerous piece of equipment: touching it will disintegrate you. So will touching it with telepathy.
exact.Jako Inżynier pamiętaj, że program monit: As an Engineer, the Supermatter Monitoring Program on modular computers give you a detailed report on the Supermatter's condition, and the contents of the air inside of the chamber, allowing you to both diagnose and monitor programs from afar!
exact.Jako Inżynier wiedz, że akcelerator cząs: As an Engineer, the Particle Accelerator that powers singularity engines is also effective at killing blobs!
exact.Jako Kapitan jesteś jednym z najważniejs: As the Captain, you are one of the highest priority targets on the station. Everything from revolutions, to nuclear operatives, to traitors that need to rob you of your unique lasgun or your life are things to worry about.
exact.Jako Kapitan masz absolutny dostęp i kon: As the Captain, you have absolute access and control over the station, but this does not mean that being a horrible person won't result in mutiny and a ban.
exact.Jako Kapitan możesz kupić nowy prom ewak: As the Captain, you can purchase a new emergency shuttle using a communications console. Some require cash, while others give you cash in exchange. Keep in mind that purchasing dangerous shuttles may instigate the ire of your crew.
exact.Jako Kapitan możesz użyć osełki, żeby za: As the Captain, you can use a whetstone to sharpen your fancy fountain pen for extra robustness.
exact.Jako Kapitan zawsze zabieraj ze sobą dys: As the Captain, always take the nuclear disk and pinpointer with you every shift. It's a good idea to give one of these to another head you can trust with keeping it safe.
exact.Jako Kapłan masz pustą laskę o właściwoś: As the Chaplain, your null rod has anti magic functions: it can destroy cultist runes by hitting them, and it makes you immune to wizard spells and cult magic.
exact.Jako Kapłan masz znacznie większe szanse: As the Chaplain, you are much more likely to get a response by praying to the gods than most people. To boost your chances, make altars with colorful crayon runes, lit candles, and wire art.
exact.Jako Kapłan wiedz, że twoja biblia jest: As the Chaplain, your bible is also a container that can store small items. Depending on your god, your starting bible may come with a surprise!
exact.Jako Klaun leczysz się lekko, jedząc ban: As the Clown, eating bananas heals you slightly. Honk!
exact.Jako Klaun masz swojego Graala – minerał: As the Clown, your Grail is the mineral bananium, which can be given to the Roboticist to build you a fun and robust mech beloved by everyone.
exact.Jako Klaun możesz przybić pieczątkę na k: As the Clown, you can use your stamp on a sheet of cardboard as the first step of making a honkbot. Fun for the whole crew!
exact.Jako Klaun pamiętaj, że samochód klauna: As the Clown, the clown car item can gain access by eating people with said access.
exact.Jako Klaun urozmaicaj swoje gimmicki! Ni: As the Clown, spice your gimmicks up! Nobody likes a one-trick pony.
exact.Jako Klaun, gdy zgubisz skórkę od banana: As the Clown, if you lose your banana peel, you can still slip people with your PDA! Honk!
exact.Jako Klaun, jeśli jesteś zdrajcą i kupis: As the Clown, if you're a Traitor and get an emag on sale (or convince another traitor), you can emag your Clown Car to unlock a variety of new functions, including the Siege Mode, which will allow you to launch your passengers, preferably directly into the Supermatter! Or into space.
exact.Jako Komendant masz koordynować ochronę,: As the Head of Security, you are expected to coordinate your security force to handle any threat that comes to the station. Sometimes it means making use of the armory to handle a blob, sometimes it means being ruthless during a revolution or cult.
exact.Jako Komendant możesz wnioskować o egzek: As the Head of Security, you can call for executions or forced cyborgization, but require the Captain's approval to carry them out.
exact.Jako Komendant nie daj, by władza uderzy: As the Head of Security, don't let the power go to your head. You may have high access, great equipment, and a miniature army at your side, but being a terrible person without a good reason is grounds for banning.
exact.Jako Kucharz możesz tworzyć mnóstwo różn: As a Cook, you can create a very wide variety of food with the crafting menu. You can find it by looking for the hammer icon near your intents.
exact.Jako Kucharz możesz zmieniać nazwy swoic: As a Cook, you can rename your custom made food with a pen.
exact.Jako Kucharz możesz ładować jedzenie do: As a Cook, you can load your food into snack vending machines.
exact.Jako Kucharz robisz jedzenie znacznie zd: As a Cook, any food you make will be much healthier than the junk food found in vendors. Having the crew routinely eating from you will provide minor buffs.
exact.Jako Kucharz w kuchni przypominasz sobie: As a Cook, being in the kitchen will make you remember the basics of Close Quarters Cooking. It is highly effective at removing Assistants from your workplace.
exact.Jako Kucharz wiedz, że większość potraw: As a Cook, most non-custom foods will have a secondary effect, ranging from healing you to making you move at lightspeed. Experiment!
exact.Jako Kultysta możesz stworzyć armię zmat: As a Cultist, you can create an army of manifested goons using a combination of the Manifest rune, which creates homunculi from ghosts, and the Blood Drain rune, which drains life from anyone standing on any blood drain rune.
exact.Jako Kultysta nie siej zbyt wiele chaosu: As a Cultist, do not cause too much chaos before your objective is completed. If the shuttle gets called too soon, you may not have enough time to win.
exact.Jako Kultysta pamiętaj, że twoja drużyna: As a Cultist, your team starts off very weak, but if necessary can quickly convert everything they have into raw power. Make sure you have the numbers and equipment to support going loud, or the cult will fall flat on its face.
exact.Jako Kultysta sprawdzaj alert w prawym g: As a Cultist, check the alert in the upper-right of your screen for all the details about your cult's current status and objective.
exact.Jako Kultysta wiedz, że runa Wrzenia Krw: As a Cultist, the Blood Boil rune will deal massive amounts of brute damage to non-cultists, stamina damage to Ratvarian scum, and some damage to fellow cultists of Nar'Sie nearby, but will create a fire where the rune stands on use.
exact.Jako Kwatermistrz możesz zbudować konsol: As the Quartermaster, you can construct an express supply console that instantly delivers crates by drop pod. The impact will cause a small explosion as well.
exact.Jako Kwatermistrz sprawdzaj manifesty w: As the Quartermaster, be sure to check the manifests on crates you receive to make sure all the info is correct. If there's a mistake, stamp the manifest DENIED and send it back in a crate with the items untouched for a refund!
exact.Jako Lekarz możesz chirurgicznie wszczep: As a Medical Doctor, you can surgically implant or extract things from people's chests. This can range from putting in a bomb to pulling out an alien larva.
exact.Jako Lekarz możesz poświecić na kogoś la: As a Medical Doctor, you can point your penlight at people to create a medical hologram. This lets them know that you're coming to treat them.
exact.Jako Lekarz możesz wyjmować implanty, tr: As a Medical Doctor, you can extract implants by holding an empty implant case in your offhand while performing the extraction step.
exact.Jako Lekarz pamiętaj, że leczenie plazma: As a Medical Doctor, treating plasmamen is not impossible! Salbutamol stops them from suffocating and showers stop them from burning alive. You can even perform surgery on them by doing the procedure on a roller bed under a shower.
exact.Jako Lekarz pamiętaj, że skan klonowania: As a Medical Doctor, clone scanning people will implant them with a health tracker that displays their vitals in the clone records. Useful to check on crew members that didn't activate suit sensors!
exact.Jako Lekarz pamiętaj: zarówno węgiel akt: As a Medical Doctor, while both heal toxin damage, the difference between charcoal and antitoxin is that charcoal will actively remove all other reagents from one's body, while antitoxin only removes various toxins - but can overdose.
As a Medical Doctor, corpses with the "...and their soul has departed" description no longer have a ghost attached to them and aren't revivable or clonable.
exact.Jako Lekarz, operując kogoś, musisz celo: As a Medical Doctor, you must target the correct limb and be on help intent when trying to perform surgery on someone. Using disarm attempt will intentionally fail the surgery step.
exact.Jako Magazynier możesz hakować MULEboty,: As a Cargo Technician, you can hack MULEbots to make them faster, run over people in their way, and even let you ride them!
exact.Jako Magazynier możesz zamawiać kontraba: As a Cargo Technician, you can order contraband items from the supply shuttle console by de-constructing it and using a multitool on the circuit board, the re-assembling it.
exact.Jako Magazynier zdobędziesz więcej punkt: As a Cargo Technician, you can earn more cargo points by shipping back crates from maintenance, liquid containers, plasma sheets, rare seeds from hydroponics, and more!

exact.Karp, larwa robaka (z antagonistą po wej: A carp, a worm larva (with the antagonist after a player enters) and a cyborg are to be taken over by ghosts (spawner menu); besides that there are a chemistry dispenser with a beaker and an airlock at the back of the arena. Repeat each step in both modes: in Preferences you toggle the old intents and combat mode. 1) On intents, take over the carp → expected: there are four intents in the HUD, the shortcuts 1-4 change them, harm turns on combat mode. In combat mode the indicator shows the combat mode state. 2) Take over the worm larva and hover the cursor over an item or a door → expected: the tooltip says "Disarm+LMB" with intents and "RMB" in combat mode. 3) Larva at the airlock: on intents set disarm and click the airlock, in combat mode click it with the right button → expected: in both modes it slips under the airlock. Negative: on the help or harm intent click that airlock → expected: the larva does not slip under. 4) On disarm use an action button from the bar (e.g. Blood Spit) → expected: it does the secondary action like RMB. 5) Cyborg on intents: click the dispenser with RMB → expected: it ejects the beaker; Shift+RMB → expected: it opens the context menu. In combat mode RMB also ejects the beaker.

exact.Kroki 1-8 mają widoczny efekt w grze, kr: Steps 1-8 have a visible effect in the game, steps 9-10 can be judged only by entries in the logs (runtime.log, qdel.log). 1) Beaker and toolbox: VV obj_integrity → expected: a value greater than 0; the grenade from the kit thrown next to them → expected: the beaker and the toolbox can be destroyed. 2) IV drip: click it with an empty hand → expected: the mode (injecting/drawing) toggles, with a message. 3) Recycler: pour things into a trash bag and throw the bag onto the recycler → expected: the contents do not return to the tile. Then emag the recycler with the emag card from the kit and repeat → expected: the same. 4) Experimentor: put a beaker into it → expected: the window shows the enhancement data of the inserted item (not of the machine itself). 5) Fireball wand: fire → expected: a fireball flies. Slice of bread + cutlet → expected: a sandwich is made. Microwave: right click → expected: it reacts without an error. 6) Pray (prayer menu) → expected: the admin gets a message with the prayer. 7) Radial menu: take a toolbox in one hand (the other empty) and click an item → expected: the tool menu appears; open and close it several times. 8) Xenomorph larva: click around it and hit it → expected: it lives and reacts normally. 9) Log only: after steps 5, 7 and 8 there are no new entries in runtime.log (null.species, spell_level, radial/slice). 10) Log only: spray with a spray bottle several times and after a few minutes check qdel.log for the GC of move_towards_budget; the result is not established.

exact.MAAMASTER -> Munitions@seegnet.nt PD: RE: MAAMASTER -> Munitions@seegnet.nt FW: RE: How the FRACK? `Attention MAAs Fleetwide, it has come to our attention your underlings may have trouble remembering simple maintenance cycle proceedures, please foward them this message as a reminder.` `--------------------------------` `FORWARDED MESSAGE` `--------------------------------` `REDACTED@seegnet.nt -> REDACTED@seegnet.net How the FRACK?` `Hey, can you help me out big time?` `I know these fancy new fighters are supposed to have some sort of special maintenance mode that lets you access all of its components and stuff, but I can't work out how the FRACK you are supposed to make it do its thing.` `PLEASE HELP ME!` `Boss will literally lynch me if I don't get this done by the time he's back.` `--------------------------------` `REDACTED@seegnet.nt -> REDACTED@seegnet.net RE:How the FRACK?` `Let me break this down for you:` `First locate the maintenance panel on the belly of the fighter, yes you have to crawl under it, take a wrench and a crowbar with you.` `Second unbolt the panel, just don't lose the nuts otherwise you are toast.` `Third slide back the maintenance panel, this should kick the fighter to go into maintenance mode, use a crowbar for leverage if it gets stuck.` `Reverse the process to reset it into flight mode at the end, simple, yes?`

The fighter has 500-1000 units of fuel. Click the tyrosene fuel pump, in the window enable "Fuel inlet" (the inlet valve), take the hose and connect it to the fighter with the engine off - fuel should flow from the fighter to the pump, with a completion message at the end. With the valve closed, the hose refuels the fighter as before. Hit the pump with the valve open with a beaker of water - the contents should go into the pump, not back into the beaker. exact.Piec łukowy kuźni amunicji, odlewa częśc: Arc furnace of the munitions forge, casts parts from silo material.
The arc furnace has its own supply of materials. Insert a mold and click with your hand: a casing made of a material or an alloy of two materials (check the cost at half), filler and a primer. A cast burns a bare hand, but not in black gloves. Place the hot part on the anvil and strike it with a smithing hammer (without the hammer the anvil refuses, putting the hammer down interrupts the forging). A window with notes (Space, at a higher grade also Q and E). Deliberately miss a few times at grade III+ and check that the grade dropped and the part has scratches. Reheat a cold part in the arc furnace (insert it and click). Assembly table: casing + primer (+ filler) -> product; grade IV/V shines. Scan the furnace, the part and the product with the analyzer, print the report in your hand. Electroplater: insert a regular box of 10mm, choose silver, after 10 s it has the silver trait and no grade in the name. Transfer 10mm casings into a Stechkin magazine and shoot at a target. Insert the torpedo warhead casing into the torpedo hull from the kit and finish the build: the torpedo should have the material in its name. Export prices: scan the products with the export scanner.

exact.Pierwszy człowiek ma już wstrzyknięte mu: The first human already has mutations injected (x-ray, telekinesis); the second is clean (control). The console stands next to the DNA scanner (linked). 1) Click the first human with the handheld sequence scanner → expected: their mutations and genetic stability are visible; the same scanner on the second → no mutations. 2) Put the first human into the DNA scanner (drag them onto the scanner, close the door), in the console select their active mutation and print a DNA nullifier → expected: an injector with its own sprite "dnanullifier" is created. 3) Print another nullifier right away → expected: refusal, the cooldown is 3x longer than a regular injector's. 4) Inject the nullifier into the first human → expected: the mutation disappears, the injector's sprite changes to the empty "dnanullifier0", the attack log has an entry about removed mutations. 5) Negative: inject a second nullifier (for a mutation the second human does not have) into the second human → expected: nothing changes; the used injector will not work again ("used up"). 6) Additionally: inject a clumsy injector into the second human and scan them with the sequence scanner → expected: a new mutation appears.

exact.Pracownia w pigułce: serwer kwantowy z k: Workshop in a nutshell: a quantum server with a console next to it (100 domain points), a netpod, a byteforge and the NexaCache shop. If you are a human with a bank account, you get 3000 np (otherwise the kit says it did not give them). Ability disks and a dungeon, an exile implant and a crowbar are in the kit. 1) In the quantum console load the domain "Clown Planet" (the cheapest, the reward is a bike horn) → expected: the server uses up points, a safehouse appears in the byteforge, and the domain is ready. 2) Enter the netpod (drag yourself onto it) → expected: you get into the domain as an avatar, the body stays in the netpod in stasis. 3) Get the crate and take it to the shipping point in the safehouse → expected: the reward flies out of the byteforge, np and a horn for you. 4) Negative: disconnect the netpod with a crowbar while you are in the domain → expected: the avatar disconnects, and the body's brain takes damage. Hololadder → expected: exits the domain. 5) Digital exile: implant another human with an exile implant and put them in the netpod → expected: after 10 s they land in the Loop, and a deposit with their things stays at the netpod. 6) In the Loop: the terminal loads domains for free, the gate lets you in, the ladder sends you back. RE: Emergency Meltdown proceedures. ` The nuclear storm drive is an inherently safe engine, however this does not mean it is foolproof. Dilligence will mean the difference between having a safe, reliable power output which can last for decades, and a nuclear hellfire which can destroy the entire ship. `What to do during a meltdown: `-A reactor will melt down when the fission inside it produces an uncontrollable amount of heat (in excess of 300 degrees celsius). If this ever happens, a shipwide alarm will sound. If you hear this alarm, you must act quickly and calmly, as you will have approximately 1 - 2 minutes before the reactor explodes. `-To avert meltdown, simply locate the control console, and choose the 'SCRAM' setting (the button labelled AZ-5). This will immediately lower all control rods and attempt to cool the reactor. `-In the event of damaged control rods, IMMEDIATELY shut off all plasma constrictors, supply pumps and filters and evacuate the engineering section IMMEDIATELY to prevent unecessary loss of life. `-As a meltdown occurs, nuclear fuel is deposited all over the ship, and must be cleaned up with a shovel. This spent fuel is HIGHLY radioactive, and must be handled with extreme care. If the unthinkable comes to pass, instruct crew to seek shelter in maintenance and proceed to immediately evacuate the ship. To avoid complications, it is recommended that engineers equip radiation proof suits and gas masks, and proceed to clear a path to the evacuation arm with shovels. Remember: Stay safe through vigilance!

The purchase and the "Unlocked" list are in the character settings (loadout tab), outside the arena. 1) In the loadout check the prices → expected: Biedronka and Lidl shopping bags (General) at 500 each, sandals with socks (Footwear) 1000, the "Polish underwear" category 1000 per design; each with an icon and a "Preview" button. 2) Click "Preview" on underwear → expected: the character in the preview wears underwear without clothes; a second click turns the preview off. 3) In the arena use the dresser before any purchase → expected: the underwear, undershirt and socks lists have no Polish designs (lock). 4) Buy one Polish underwear design, enter the chamber again and use the dresser → expected: the purchased design is on the list, the other unpurchased ones are still hidden. 5) In the loadout the purchased design has the label "Unlocked" and can be selected in Underwear/Undershirt/Socks. 6) Negative: try to buy an item with a balance below the price → expected: refusal, nothing deducted. Set an unpurchased design and load the character → expected: it changes to "Nude". 7) Pick up and wear the items in the arena (shopping bags, sandals) → expected: correct sprites; the shopping bag holds items.

Ctrl+click is a grab, Shift+right opens the context menu, Alt+left/Alt+right rotates a chair. Airlock: the welder repairs, right click welds it shut. Window: without combat mode you knock, in combat mode you smash. CQC book: the combo counter in the HUD and a guide window. In combat mode a point-blank shot hits with the stock, without it it fires. Then turn on "Old intent mode" in Preferences: four intents in the HUD, harm = combat, disarm = right click, the right button opens the menu again.

exact.Wejdź do myśliwca (klik, 2 s) → oczekiwa: Enter the fighter (click, 2 s) → expected: at the bottom of the screen a panel with captions in Polish (WEAPON SELECT, FLIGHT MODE, CONTROLS, HULL STATUS, CATAPULT) and a message about the panel in chat. 1) Press Alt, then C, then space (shortcut mode) → expected: the corresponding key on the panel is briefly pressed, FLIGHT/BRAKE, MOUSE/KEYS and PDC/TORPEDO change according to state. 2) Click the keys on the panel (ALT, C, space) → expected: the same as the shortcuts, plus beeping. Shift+click on the panel → description in chat. 3) Hit the fighter (with no pilot or when you are sitting and someone else hits it) → expected: hull status drops through 75%/50% (WARNING)/25% (ALARM) to EJECT. 4) Drag the panel with the mouse → it stays in the new place. Negative: drop it far beyond the screen edge → expected: it stops at the edge, fully visible, and can be grabbed back. The COLLAPSE tab above the panel → the panel disappears, the CONSOLE tab stays where its bottom edge was; clicking it expands the panel. Leave and board again → the panel stays collapsed. The verb “Show/hide console panel” in the Ship tab hides and shows the panel. 5) Negative: flip both L and R switches (the chamber is aboard) → expected: refusal “You are aboard the ship…”, the switches return on their own after 5 s. Outside the chamber: fly the fighter into space, flip L and R within 5 s → escape pod with you in it, ejection sound, the fighter stays empty with the brake on. At the helm of a ship (bridge) the helmsman panel, at the tactical console the gunner panel (PDC/TORPEDO/RAILGUN); with a zoomed-out camera the panel should be larger and legible. Sounds: turn on the APU (startup), the battery (switch), launch from the deck catapult, Ctrl+click on an enemy ship (targeting), turbolift doors.

exact.Weź kamerę reporterską do ręki i użyj je: Take the reporter camera in hand and use it: the TV should turn on and say "... - now LIVE!", and the PDA should beep with a Spess.tv notification. exact.Weź kartę kuchni i baru. Na terminalu re: Take the kitchen and bar card. On the restaurant terminal click Open the establishment: the first robot arrives after a few seconds, the next ones every 80-100 s (the bar every 40-60 s). The seats at the tables and stools are already set out; also check Remove Free, Set Out Seats and Issue Projector. The robot sits down, turns to the table and orders (a bubble over the head, the terminal says the order). Hand the dish to them or put it on the table in front of them: they should leave a holochip and vanish into a portal. A wrong dish they should reject. exact.Zestaw „zrób to sam” do zbudowania własn: A DIY kit for building your own shuttle! Comes with all the parts you need to get your people to the stars!

exact.Zestaw, który pozwala jednostkom pomocni: A kit that allows utility fighters to transfer fuel and power to another fighter.
exact.Zestaw: 2 kanistry plazmy, klucz i zapas: Kit: 2 plasma canisters, a wrench and the captain's spare ID. 1) Enter the Sabre in the hangar. In the hold next to the bed there is the fuel connector (yellow frame) with a plasma canister on it, and next to it, in the floor, the Sabre fuel heater. In the hangar next to the Sabre a plasma canister stands where the cryofuel tank was (tanks further from the Sabre stay for the fighters). Examine the heater → it shows the moles of gas; examine the hatch from outside → “Fuel: X/2500”. 2) Wrench the canister standing on the connector (or roll in another one) → the Sabre's fuel goes up (pilot window, hatch description). One full canister gives an almost full tank. 3) Fly on the overmap → fuel goes down; faster under thrust than idling. With zero fuel the helm refuses to launch (negative). 4) A cryofuel hose from the tank by the fighters clicked on the Sabre hatch → message that the Sabre runs on plasma, fuel unchanged (negative). A fighter refuels with the hose as before. 5) In-flight refuelling kit: the Sabre refuels a fighter → fuel goes across, the Sabre loses plasma.
exact.Zestaw: Wyznacznik Stref Promu, RCD, ste: Kit: Rapid Shuttle Designator, RCD, shuttle flight controller, void engine, plasma engine with heater, plasma canister, cryogenic fuel tank and the captain's spare ID. 1) Sabre on the map: the hangar (on Atlas the mining bay in the south, nose east towards the doors, and the widened hangar next to Trafalgar, nose north) holds the Sabre interior, without a sprite. The hull on an east-facing port has its picture turned as a whole, with no shuffled pieces. The „Sabre hangar doors” button by the doors opens and closes them. Empty hand on the left nacelle (hatch) → you get inside; without pilot/miner access → „Access denied” (negative). The doors in the cockpit → you step out onto the tile in front of the hatch. 2) Service: the hose from the cryogenic fuel tank by the hatch, clicked on the hatch → refuels the Sabre (examining the hatch shows the fuel); an ID on the hatch → the maintenance/eject mode window; dragging a crate onto the hatch → cargo hold. 3) Launch: the helm in the cockpit → the „Take off?” question, Launch → the interior disappears from the hangar, the Sabre is on the overmap next to the ship and the helm flies it like a dropship. With an empty tank the launch is refused (negative). In flight the doors are locked. 4) Landing: turn on docking mode and fly into the ship → a message about looking for a spot, the interior returns to its port in the hangar. At a target without a port (abandoned station, asteroid) → the interior sets down in space next to the target's hull so that the doors open onto the target's floor (if there is a free spot by the floor). 5) Shuttle from the Designator: build a small room with the RCD with a floor, an outer wall and an airlock, put the flight controller and an engine inside (the void engine works without fuel; the plasma engine needs a heater facing the same way and plasma from the canister), designate the shuttle with the Designator and use it on the airlock. Controller → „Take off?” → the shuttle flies around the overmap with its own sprite, coming back in docking mode to the building site. Without engines or without fuel the launch is refused with a message (negative).
exact.Zestaw: dwie sterty śmieci, dzwonki, kos: Kit: two piles of trash, bells, a disposal bin with an outlet, an RPD, tools, an emag, loaves, a brain and a medical headset. 1) Trash pile: LMB (rummaging) → expected: trash flies at you, and once per pile a maint loot drops (a second attempt on the same pile for the same player gives no loot). An item in hand + click on the pile → it is tucked inside; RMB → you hide yourself (and you can get out of there). 2) Medical bell: click → expected: ringing and a medbay call over the radio (the medical headset will show the message), another ring within a minute only rings without a call (negative: once per minute). Carry it out of the area → it turns on GPS. A regular bell: unwrench with a wrench. 3) Loafer: wrench down the disposal bin and the outlet, with the RPD (Disposal → Loafer) build pipes and a loafer segment between them (add the remaining pipe sections), throw items and a loaf into the bin → expected: at the outlet a prison loaf of greater density drops out; throw in a brain too (negative: the brain and heads from the blacklist pass through without being pressed). Emag on the loafer: a message about disabling safety limits, a fried mechanism in examine. 4) Loaf with a rod: throw it at a wall or someone → expected: after the throw it releases a stationary rod.
exact.Zestaw: dwóch ludzi (pierwszy to przywód: Kit: two humans (the first is the revolution leader), a communications console, a spare captain's card, a cargo bounty console with two ammo bounties and the parts for them. On a server (not in CI) the kit also opens the mission choice, as at round start. 1) Emote wheel: the smiley button in the action row (top left corner). Empty, it opens the Emote Panel with a hint → star 13 emotes, click the button once more → expected: the wheel has 12 emotes plus the Emote Panel slot (the 13th does not fit, negative), an emote from the wheel is performed, after a reconnect the selection stays. 2) Revolution: take over the leader. The red R button on the left side of the screen → expected: a panel with slots (yours with an outline), a limit marker, locked slots and counters comrades / limit, leaders, heads. Hover over the slots → tooltips. 3) Limit: VV the revolution team (from the antagonist panel) and set rev_cap = 1 → expected: the counter shows 1 free slot fewer; the leader's speech on a target with a client (a second player or an admin in the second human's body; requires a second player) works once, after the limit is filled the speech refuses (negative). Adding a revolutionary via the Antag Panel bypasses the limit. 4) Ammo bounties: cargo bounty console → expected: the bounties "Trigger electronics" (2 pcs) and "Loading trays" (2 pcs) with a description, reward and progress 0/2. The trigger electronics ×2 and trays ×2 lying nearby match wanted_types; full completion requires sending them by cargo shuttle (requires a shuttle flight), and without shipping the bounty stays open (negative: it does not complete just by lying there). 5) Mission choice: log in with the captain's card at the communications console, the Mission Status tab → expected: three different missions (the first is the current one), after the choice an announcement "Captain … accepted the mission" and a briefing. Without the captain's card the tab does not show a choice (negative). If a mission was already chosen or the mode was forced by an admin, the tab shows only the status; then the kit does not open the choice a second time.
exact.Zestaw: gotowy VIM z butlą, corgi i kot,: The kit: a ready VIM with a tank, a corgi and a cat, parts for assembling a second VIM, two Citationinators, an emag, a security HUD, a spare captain's card (security access), a blank Midshipman card (no access) and a human "Test Citizen" entered in the manifest with the SSD marker set. 1) VIM: take over the corgi or the cat (admin: Possess on a mob; ghost player: Haunt) and drag yourself onto the ready VIM (requires a player in the pet role) → expected: you get in, the VIM drives fast, you hear the servos, "nominal" at full HP. Actions: Ding! and Bzzz. (renew), headlights give a cone of light, exiting throws you outside. 2) Assemble the second one from parts: an EVA helmet on the ground, then a robot leg, a second leg, a flashlight, a screwdriver, a voice module, a screwdriver, a tank → expected: after the last step a VIM is made. Damage it and repair it with a welder outside combat mode → expected: +20 HP every approx. 2.5 s. Negative: the welder in combat mode hits it instead of repairing; a destroyed VIM does not explode, oil and sparks remain, the tank drops out. 3) SSD: "Test Citizen" has a marker above their head, and examine says "They have been away for 3 min." → expected: the marker and the minutes are visible. The real test (disconnecting with a character, the marker disappearing after returning, leaving as a ghost and dying) requires a second client; without it check only death: kill the Citizen → the marker disappears. 4) The Citationinator with the captain's card in hand (or worn), use it in hand → From the crew manifest → choose "Test Citizen (Midshipman)", amount 50, reason "test" → expected: a pink slip with a table (fined, amount, issued by) drops out, and the fine goes to the records (the security HUD on the Citizen's eyes or the records console). The Outside the manifest variant: enter any name → a slip without a records entry. 5) Negative: take a blank Midshipman card (no access) and use the Citationinator → "no access!"; with no card at all → "no ID!". Emag on the device → sparks, "access bypass lock", after which it works without a card.
exact.Zestaw: kajdanki, laser, defibrylator. 1: Kit: handcuffs, laser, defibrillator. 1) Statistics: fire the laser a few times, handcuff the test subject, then Esc → Statistics (or OOC → Statistics) → the „My characters” tab, at the top the „This round” section with shots fired and handcuffings. Handcuffing yourself does not count (negative). The „Earnings Ranking” tab shows the all-time ranking. Saved to the database only at the end of the round: after the restart the same numbers are in the character tab, and rounds played go up by 1. 2) Revival: kill the test subject (a revivable body) and bring it back with the defibrillator → „Defibrillator revivals” goes up by 1 in the window. Outside the chamber: the mining vendor sells „200 space credits” for 1200 points. Bonus: as a scientist, sell an artifact at the xenoarchaeology console and wait for the payday (every 5 minutes) → the card says „Department bonus (science) for the department's work: X cr.”. Malfunctioning AI: an admin sets the malf mode with at least 15 players and a volunteer with the „Malfunctioning AI” preference and the AI job; without such a player the mode does not start (negative).
exact.Zestaw: konsola łączności i zapasowa kar: Kit: communications console and the captain's spare ID. On the server (not in CI) the kit asks whether to add the Abandoned station mission with a chosen objective, and then whether to open the next mission choice. 1) Abandoned station: after adding the mission the admin log shows „station interior ready on Z level …”, and the briefing (communications console, Mission status) shows the objective text, system and reward. A grey abandoned station appears on the overmap in that system. A dropship or a fighter with an FTL drive and a docking computer in docking mode flies into the station → expected: it appears in space next to a ruin with rooms and corridors in one of the themes (abandoned, blob, xenomorphs, netherworld, Ratvar). A regular fighter without FTL doesn't dock (negative, same as station boarding). 2) Objectives (chosen when adding): black box (GPS „CZARNA SKRZYNKA”) used in hand on the ship's bridge → balloon, announcement with the amount and the mission COMPLETED; artifact brought to the ship → completed; nuclear decommissioning → Central Command report with the code, the bomb drops in a pod on the station, the disk lies elsewhere, after arming and the explosion everyone on the station level dies, mission completed, and an armed bomb taken off the station level disarms (negative); VIP brought to the ship alive and conscious → completed, dead VIP without a player → FAILED; assassination → completed after the target dies. The VIP and the assassination target are ghost roles (Haunt / spawner). 3) Next mission: after all objectives are done, the „additional objectives” vote (or the kit's prompt) → an announcement about the choice; at the console with the captain's ID, a list of missions from the roll (Abandoned station included; without Armada, galactic conquest and the Dolos assault) and „Attack on Rubicon” if there are enemies there. Picking a mission → a new briefing with its objectives, after it is done the vote comes again. Picking Rubicon → the clear Rubicon objective, then return home. Without the captain's ID you can't choose (negative). Without a choice after 5 minutes command assigns objectives the old way.
exact.Zestaw: strzelba bojowa z amunicją śruto: Kit: combat shotgun with buckshot and slugs, sniper rifle, grenade launcher, bow with arrows, wand, chem gun, syringe gun, toy pistol, regular pistol. Turn on combat mode and take the gun off safety. 1) Crosshair shape: pistol = corners, sniper rifle = T-cross, grenade launcher and syringe gun = grid, bow = ring, wand = cloud, chem gun = dashed ring, toy = orange cross. Every shape spreads out while moving and during bursts like the corners. 2) Shotgun: with buckshot the crosshair is arcs on the sides; after a shot, before you rack, the arcs stay; a slug in the chamber → corners. 3) Buckshot on the move: shoot buckshot at a wall standing still, then running and sprinting → on the move the marks spread wider (before they were always equally tight). The combat shotgun is heavy and fires only two-handed. 4) Movement penalty: walking spreads the crosshair a little, running more, sprinting the most; after stopping from a sprint it narrows over about a second. Check both control modes. 5) Shooting around a corner: stand by a wall corner, hold C and lean with the arrow keys towards the opening (up to the tile edge) → the bullet leaves from where you lean and clears the corner; without leaning it hits the wall. 6) Alexis-BOR in hand: turn in all four directions → the rifle is held diagonally at your side, differently for each direction.
exact.Zestaw: trzy szklanki, pudełko dekoracji: Kit: three glasses, a box of garnishes, fruits and a knife, wirecutters, a cable, gold, silver, a lighter, a tablet with Lifeline and a human "Test Crewmember" with sensors. Beakers also lie around: one with salt, another with ash (20 u each). 1) Alt-click on a glass → expected: the glass changes shape (a sprite variant). 2) Garnishes: take an umbrella or a garnish from the box and click the glass with it → expected: the garnish appears on the glass and vanishes from the hand. Negative: a second garnish on the same side (e.g. a lime and then a cherry) → "There is already something on this part of the glass!"; washing the glass (sink/water) removes the garnishes. 3) Slices: with a knife in hand click a lime, a lemon, an orange and cherries → expected: slices are made (a lime gives a lime slice). Wirecutters on a cable, silver and gold → expected: wire and silver and gold rims. 4) Rims: heat the beaker with salt with a lighter to approx. 600 K (the beaker in hand, a lit lighter) → expected: the salt turns into a salt rim for a glass; the same with ash (an ash rim). Negative: salt below 600 K gives nothing. 5) Lifeline: run the program on the tablet → expected: a crew list with "Test Crewmember" (name and job from the card), their distance, direction and area; a human with a sensor on full tracking. When you move away a few tiles, the distance grows.
exact.Zestaw: zestaw budowy promu i zapasowa k: Kit: shuttle construction kit and the captain's spare ID. 1) Wings: in the Sabre hangar step onto a side nacelle (the floor next to the hatch) → you can walk on it. Click the cockpit doors (between the nacelle and the cockpit) → after 2 seconds you are inside; without access → „Access denied” (negative). From the inside, clicking the doors → you step out in front of the hatch. 2) Launching with someone on the wing: someone stands on the wing and the pilot tries to take off → refused with „Someone is standing on the wing” (negative); once they step off the launch works. 3) Shuttle construction kit: open the toolbox → a Rapid Shuttle Designator, a shuttle flight controller board, 2 plasma engine boards and 2 heater boards. Every map has such a toolbox in engineering (Atlas: the engineering break room).

It is anticipated that your extreme location and decreased surveillance could pose security risks. Avoid unnecessary risks and attempt to keep your station in one piece.
exact.Zgodnie z oczekiwaniami z małp, które wc: As expected, all that is left of the monkeys we sent in earlier is a group of xenomorph larvae. It is quite clear that the facehuggers are not selective in their hosts, and so far the gestation process has been shown to have a 100% success rate.

exact.Zielone naklejki płytek z Bee: pełna, po: Green tile stickers from Bee: full, half, anti-corner, corner, ramps and opposite corners, then patches of carpet, grass and glass floor of 2x2 tiles each. 1) Look at the stickers → expected: they are semi-transparent, and the ramps give a diagonal transition. 2) Look at the carpet, grass and glass patches → expected: adjacent tiles join by bitmask into one surface, and the edges of a patch have separate corners. 3) Negative: deconstruct one carpet tile from the middle of a patch with a crowbar → expected: the other tiles recalculate their edges, with no gaps or artifacts.

exact.Zlecenia: włóż kartę do konsoli zleceń,: Bounties: put a card into the bounty console, take a new bounty and choose one of three. A security card usually gets a patrol - go for a walk with it and watch the progress messages. The "Ship bounties" tab - download the list and print it. Test cube: use it in hand with a card, scan it with the export scanner (tip), watch the bonus countdown. Beacon: click several times quickly - it should drop only one pad, and on the second use the console. Stock exchange: buy sheets with the card and (the cargo card) from the supply budget, put gold/iron into the machine and look at the stock block. exact.text: 'Każda udzielona lekcja dodaje nam: text: 'Every lesson given adds to our strength. With right click we can turn walls into glass to reach even further.',
exact.text: 'Koniec rundy został opóźniony. Ch: text: 'The round end was delayed, would you like to start Battle Royale?',
exact.text: 'Korporacja DeForest stworzyła jed: text: 'The DeForest Corporation has created single-use testers that detect blood worms. Security can order them from cargo. They work instantly, but they hurt and are expensive.',
exact.text: 'Larwy chodzą rurami wentylacji. P: text: 'Larvae travel through ventilation pipes. After maturing you lose this ability and are left with slipping under doors, breaking doors down and ID access. Before you mature, find a good spot or a host.',
exact.text: 'Leczenie nosiciela w medbayu zami: text: 'Healing a host in medbay instead of with your own blood does not leave them deathly pale and saves blood for spitting and healing.',
exact.text: 'Lodówki z krwią w medbayu to niez: text: 'Blood fridges in medbay are a decent source of synthetic blood when there are no monkeys. Be careful, breaking a fridge can be heard through walls.',
exact.text: 'Mały zasięg ataku i znikome obraż: text: 'Short attack range and negligible damage, but great for quick escapes and repositioning.',
exact.text: 'Możesz wyjść z nosiciela, by kogo: text: 'You can leave a host to surprise someone, especially as an adult. Cut off escape routes first, because exiting takes 3 seconds.',
exact.text: 'Nie musisz oddychać. Dotyczy to t: text: 'You do not need to breathe. This applies to your hosts as well.',
exact.text: 'Nosiciel nie potrzebuje oddychać: text: 'A host does not need to breathe or have a working heart and liver, a brain is enough. You can revive a dead host with its own blood.',
exact.text: 'Nosicielom brakuje twoich zmysłów: text: 'Hosts lack your senses, so darkness and flashbangs affect them normally. Night vision goggles, eye protection and ear protection will help.',
exact.text: 'Ochrona cię złapała? Z aktywnym P: text: 'Caught by security? With Blood Spit active, right click dissolves handcuffs, straitjackets and even locker hinges. You can also leave the host and escape through the vents or through the door.',
exact.text: 'Pamiętaj, że jesteś fizycznie poł: text: 'Remember that you are physically linked to this presence. You are a foreign body in a hostile environment. It will attempt to forcefully eject you.',
exact.text: 'Po podłączeniu jesteś w miarę bez: text: 'While connected, you are somewhat safe from environmental hazards and intrusions, but not completely. Pay close attention to alerts.',
exact.text: 'Postęp wzrostu widać na przycisku: text: 'Growth progress is visible on the maturation button and when hovering over the worm icon in the top right corner. Once you have grown, seal yourself in a cocoon to advance to the next stage. A young worm spits blood, and an adult is extremely strong.',
exact.text: 'Potrafisz zamienić się w krew i w: text: 'You can turn into blood and enter a human corpse, making it your host. You can also drag yourself onto a corpse.',
exact.text: 'Powoli się leczysz, z progu śmier: text: 'You heal slowly, from the brink of death to full health in about 5 minutes. In a host this means slowly regaining blood. By injecting blood you quickly heal the host at the cost of your own health.',
exact.text: 'Rośniesz, pijąc krew Wysysaniem k: text: 'You grow by drinking blood with Blood Drain or by entering corpses. Synthetic blood, e.g. from monkeys and blood bags, counts towards growth only up to a certain limit. The HUD shows the blood level of everyone, and examining a target tells you how much blood they have and how much they would give you.',
exact.text: 'Tworzenie awatarów zżera ogromną: text: 'Generating avatars costs tremendous bandwidth. Do not waste them.',
exact.text: 'Twój umysł nie jest ludzki. Nie z: text: 'Your mind is not human. You know no fear, even in a host.',
exact.text: 'W kosmosie jesteś niewidzialny i: text: 'In space you are invisible and your wounds heal. You pass freely through glass, but an electrified grille will stop you.',
exact.text: 'W nosicielu cały jesteś krwią, wi: text: 'Inside a host you are entirely blood, so their bleeding hurts you directly. Hosts also bleed after death and 50% faster than normal humans.',
exact.text: 'Wnikając w zwłoki, błyskawicznie: text: 'By entering a corpse, you instantly drink all of its blood. Blood obtained while already in a host does not count towards growth.',
exact.text: 'Wpatruj się w ofiarę, która cię w: text: 'Stare at a victim who sees you to stun and weaken them. This is how you give away your presence.',
exact.text: 'Wysysasz powietrze prosto z płuc: text: 'You suck the air straight out of their lungs and quickly take down even the strongest. If they resist, right click deals normal damage. Your hands are only good for carrying things.',
exact.text: 'Zanieś skrzynię na wyznaczone mie: text: 'Bring the crate to the designated sending location in the safehouse. The area may seem out of place. Examine the safehouse to find it.',
exact.text: 'Zbadaj okolicę i zrób, co trzeba,: text: 'Study the area and do what needs to be done to recover the crate. Pay close attention to domain information and context clues.',
exact.text: 'Źle znosisz wysoką temperaturę i: text: 'You tolerate high temperatures poorly and burn up quickly in them. This also applies inside a host, unless you dress them in a fireproof outfit.',
